quest.title: Charity Event? Securing Funds?
quest.description: Bernhard, a Knight of Favonius, appears to have encountered some trouble this Weinlesefest...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

talks.objective: Take a stroll around The Weinlesefest

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: Wait! Honorary Knight! And Paimon, the best guide in Teyvat!

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: I humbly beg for your assistance!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Did Paimon hear that right? Is Paimon finally starting to make a name for herself?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, wait... haven't we met...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, in the main hall of the Knights of Favonius Headquarters.

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: That's right. I am Bernhard, a member of the Logistics Company under Captain Hertha.

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: Normally, I would hope to become better acquainted before asking for a favor like this... but time's running out, so I really have no choice.

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: Please help me rescue the charity event!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Rescue"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The charity event? Oh right, Master Jean mentioned that. So what's happened?

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: Well, the Knights of Favonius wants to run a stall during the festival...

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: The idea is for all profits from the sales to go to charity. Specifically, the funds will provide support to disadvantaged children and elderly citizens.

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: We drew lots to decide whose job it would be, and as it happened... I was the lucky winner. I really didn't want to screw this up, so I asked all around for advice, but...

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: My experience is in inventory and shipping. Now I'm supposed to run a whole shop, but it took me forever just to think of what to sell... I'm already completely out of my depth.

dialogues.speaker: Bernhard
dialogues.text: And that is why I humbly beseech you to render your assistance...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Also, no need to be so formal.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, you said this is to help out the kids and old folks of Mondstadt, right? Sounds like a great cause!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME} is an Honorary Knight, and Paimon's a longtime friend of Favonius. We'll be more than happy to do our part.

choices.text: As Paimon says, we are happy to help.

response.speaker: Bernhard
response.text: Oh, I can't thank you enough! Right, let me get down to brass tacks...

response.speaker: Bernhard
response.text: Before we can open shop, we need to amass a supply of <color=#00E1FFFF>Fairbrew Jellies</color>. This is the basic currency that we will use when running the stall.

response.speaker: Bernhard
response.text: The wine merchants in the area are in dire need of raw ingredients for wine-making. Sell them raw ingredients, and they will pay you generously in Fairbrew Jellies.

response.speaker: Bernhard
response.text: Also, there are some international customers looking to purchase beverages in bulk during the Weinlesefest period. They're on the market for an agent to handle their purchase orders.

response.speaker: Bernhard
response.text: In the interests of establishing a long-term business relationship, these customers are usually willing to offer a generous price, and there's also room for negotiation with the wine merchants.

response.speaker: Bernhard
response.text: The price difference is ours to keep as commission, and you can cash that amount in for Fairbrew Jellies.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So to sum up, our job is to sell ingredients to the wine merchants, and place orders for international customers, making sure to negotiate the price. Right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds much easier than Paimon imagined!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We're pretty good at this.

response.speaker: Bernhard
response.text: R—Really? Well, that's wonderful!

response.speaker: Bernhard
response.text: I have one order here with me already: A Mr. Shevirme from Sumeru wishes to purchase <color=#00E1FFFF>50 crates of Fruits of the Festival</color>.

response.speaker: Bernhard
response.text: These beverages can be bought from the <color=#00E1FFFF>Angel's Share's stand</color>. The shopkeeper's name is <color=#00E1FFFF>Georg</color>.

response.speaker: Bernhard
response.text: He's a very nice man, but he won't be pushed around. Please consider the price carefully and try to reach a good deal with Georg.

response.speaker: Bernhard
response.text: I should carry on setting up the stall now. Once you've gathered enough Fairbrew Jellies, come back here and we'll take it from there.

response.speaker: Bernhard
response.text: You won't need to worry about the supplies for the shop.

response.speaker: Bernhard
response.text: I'm already in contact with the suppliers, and they'll send everything over once the funds are in place.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, sounds good! We'll find the funds and you sort out the shop.

response.speaker: Bernhard
response.text: This is an enormous help. Thank you both ever so much!

choices.text: What do you need from us?
Everyone has things that they struggle with.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi there, Georg. We're Shevirme's agents. He's asked us to order 50 crates of Fruits of the Festival for him.

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Oh? Did you say Shevirme? He's a regular customer of mine. Always orders around the same amount each time...

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: But I digress — what price are you offering this year?

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: As usual, I will arrange for someone to deliver the goods directly to Shevirme's place of business.

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: You won't have to worry about a thing. Just make sure you keep hold of this receipt.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, let's keep bringing the funds in. We gotta work quickly if we wanna gather all these Fairbrew Jellies in time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bernhard says we can approach this however we want, just as long as we raise all the funds we need...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We get a commission for every order we help place for an international customer. So maybe it's not worth trying to sell loads of ingredients to the wine merchants...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still... just to make sure we've covered everything, let's take a look at the other wine merchants.

talks.objective: Check out the situation in other shops in advance

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! You're here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! It's Barbara!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Thanks! And happy Weinlesefest to you, too!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: This festival is one of the most popular ones in Mondstadt. I'm so happy I ran into you guys here. I hope you have a great time!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Oh, also, I heard from Georg that you're collecting Fairbrew Jellies?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I'm just curious, are you helping out with the Knights of Favonius charity event?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We sure are! Everybody's gotta do their part, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The stall isn't up and running yet. We're busy raising funds so they can open for business!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's sure to be a bunch of other problems to deal with once it's open, but whatever comes up, we'll deal with it!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Wonderful! Heehee... they're lucky to have you. Now that you've joined the team, I just know it'll be a huge success!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thanks for your encouragement!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I helped out at a small charity sale for the Knights once, too.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Although... my only contribution was standing out front and singing...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Oh! And I also met the bard, Venti there! He even persuaded me to perform an impromptu song with him...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: The music he plays is quite refined and elegant. At first, I didn't want to sing too loudly, in case I ruined the style he was going for...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: But he sang a harmony to guide me in, and before long, we were sounding great.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: In the end, the audience loved it, and we sold a lot at the event.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So Barbara's worked with the Tone-Deaf Bard before...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I wish I could have been there to hear it.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Yeah... too bad we couldn't fit it into the schedule this year.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: The Church of Favonius wants to hold a sung poetry event somewhere with a nice view during the festival, which means I have to go to rehearsal...

choices.text: Go do what you have to do, it's alright.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, sounds like we've each got our own important work to do. Let's give it our all.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Thank you both! Well, maybe I can't stay here and sing, but I still wanna do a little something to contribute!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I can, um... I can help promote your stall.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Hmm... Should I make some big posters? Or maybe some flyers to hand out?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I'll have to pick a memorable slogan, too! And maybe it'll seem more sincere if I sign them...?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Then again, maybe telling people in person would be more effective...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, with Barbara helping out on the marketing side, this charity event will get loads more attention!

choices.text: Sounds like a lot of effort...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: It's fine, really! It won't take me too long. Now I feel a little embarrassed, heh...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: #Let me think about it a little more and talk to some other people about their marketing experience! {NICKNAME}, Paimon, I'll see you later~

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: And, um... the Knights and the Church of Favonius are really proud of you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aww, thanks! We'll do our best.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon's even more motivated than ever now! {NICKNAME}, we gotta make sure we do a really great job here!

choices.text: You have so much on your plate already.
We'll take care of the charity event.

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: I'm sorry — Did you even speak to Shevirme before deciding on a price? You must be joking, that's much too low.

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Look, I know we've had a great harvest this year and our production costs have gone down a fair amount, but even then... I'm afraid this price is just not doable.

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Sounds good to me, that's around the same price we've agreed in previous years, too. We have a deal!

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: Hmm... A little lower than I was hoping for. But he's a reliable customer. I think I can make it work.

dialogues.speaker: Georg
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, but I just can't consider going that low. If you're serious about placing an order, please, just take my price.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, there are a ton of sellers at the Weinlesefest. Should be some pretty cool stuff to check out, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go and browse while we still have the chance!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That must be Georg. Let's go talk business!
